title: Severe Cyclone Warning: Cyclone 'Asani'
description: Cyclone Asani is expected to make landfall with wind speeds up to 120 km/h. High storm surge expected in low-lying coastal belts. Evacuate designated areas immediately.
instructions: Move livestock to elevated concrete shelters. Secure loose roof sheets. Turn off main power switches. Stay indoors.

title: River Water Level Alert: Ganga Basin
description: River Ganga water levels are rising rapidly at Patna gauge station and have exceeded the warning mark by 0.65 meters. Immediate catchment flooding expected.
instructions: Avoid crossing river bridges. Move farm equipment away from shallow riverbanks. Prepare clean drinking water reserves.

title: Thunderstorm and Lightning Strike Warning
description: Scattered thunderstorms accompanied by high-density lightning strikes are expected over the next 6 hours in Patna block.
instructions: Do not seek shelter under tall trees or standalone electricity poles during rains. Move indoors. Unplug electronic farm devices.

title: Severe Heatwave Conditions
description: Maximum temperatures are likely to hover around 44-46 degrees Celsius for the next 3 days. High thermal index risks.
instructions: Avoid field operations between 11:30 AM and 3:30 PM. Keep livestock in well-ventilated shaded zones. Drink saline-electrolyte water.
